body:
You can place an order and message us on WhatsApp in the same step. It is still a full order on our website, not a separate chat-only process, which means it gets an order ID, a private status page and email confirmations just like any other order. WhatsApp is simply a convenient way to talk to us about it. This guide explains how the option works, why we save the order on the site, what to expect in the chat for each payment method, how to send screenshots, how to stay protected from scams and when WhatsApp is the best channel. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## How it works
At checkout, fill in your details, confirm you are 21 or older and choose your payment method. Then choose "Place order and message us on WhatsApp" instead of the standard place-order button. We save your order, send your confirmation email and open WhatsApp with a message that includes your order reference, the items, the total and the payment method. You send that message to us, and a team member replies. If WhatsApp does not open automatically, use the link on the confirmation page, or message us at +1 774-734-1372 with your order ID.

## Why we save it on the site
A saved order gets an ID, a private status page and an email confirmation. It also lets us send payment details, track proof of payment and keep a written record of what you ordered and what you paid. Chat messages alone can be lost or misread, and the saved order gives both of us a clear reference. It also means that the price is calculated by our server from the catalog, so the total in your message is exactly what we will charge.

## What to expect in chat
What we send depends on your payment method.

### Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime
We reply with the payment details, and a link to your private tap-to-copy page. You pay the exact amount, add your order ID in the note and upload a screenshot. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/) and the guides for [Cash App](/blog/cash-app-payments-guide/), [Apple Pay](/blog/apple-pay-payments-guide/) and [Chime](/blog/chime-payments-guide/).

### Gift cards
We reply with the buy link for your card and your private upload link. You buy the card, then upload the code and receipt. See [how gift card payment works](/blog/how-gift-card-payment-works/).

### Cryptocurrency
Crypto payments use the payment window on the site, which shows the amount, a QR code and the address. Chat is for questions. We never send crypto addresses in chat as a substitute for the window, and you should copy the address from the window, not from a message. See [how to pay with Bitcoin](/blog/how-to-pay-with-bitcoin/).

## Sending screenshots
You can upload proof on the private order page or send images in chat. The page is easier to track, so we recommend it, because uploads attach directly to your order. If you send images in chat, include your order ID in the message so we can match it. See [how to upload a payment screenshot](/blog/how-to-upload-a-payment-screenshot/).

## Staying protected
Only trust our official number listed on the [contact page](/contact/). We will never ask you to pay to a personal number or account that we have not already provided through your order, and we will never ask for card numbers, PINs, passwords, private keys or recovery phrases in chat. If someone messages you claiming to be from the store from a different number, do not pay and contact us through the website. If a message pressures you to pay urgently or keep a payment secret, stop. See [gift card code security tips](/blog/gift-card-code-security-tips/).

## When WhatsApp is the best channel
- **Quick questions** about an order, a product or a payment.
- **Receiving payment details** in a chat you can see on your phone.
- **Sending a photo** of a card or a receipt.
- **Checking on a parcel** with your order ID.

For anything that needs a formal record, such as a damage claim or a return, follow up by email as well. See [how to contact support](/blog/how-to-contact-support/).

## Good to know
You still need an email address, because confirmations, tracking and your private link go there. Delivery still needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign. The minimum order, the free-shipping rule, the 10% discount for crypto and gift cards and the returns policy are the same as for any order. See [how ordering works](/blog/how-ordering-works/).

## Hours and response
WhatsApp messages are answered during our customer service hours, Monday to Friday, 8AM to 5PM Arizona time. If you message us outside those hours, we reply on the next business day. Your order is saved on the site either way, and you can follow it from your private page. Automatic crypto payments continue to be matched outside business hours.

## Common problems
### WhatsApp does not open
Use the link on the confirmation page, or open WhatsApp yourself and message +1 774-734-1372 with your order ID. If you use a computer, WhatsApp Web works too.

### I closed the chat before sending
Your order is still saved. Message us with your order ID and we will continue from there.

### I sent the message from a different number
Tell us, and give us your order ID and the name and email on the order, so we can confirm it is you.

### I want to change the order
Tell us in the chat with your order ID. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Is it cheaper to order through WhatsApp?
No. The price is the same, and the discount depends on your payment method, not the channel.

### Can I order entirely in chat without using the website?
We need the order to be placed on the website so that it can be priced and saved. Use the WhatsApp option at checkout, and we will take it from there.

### Can I pay inside WhatsApp?
No. Payment is made through the method you chose, for example your payment app or a crypto wallet, using the details we send.

### Will my chat be private?
WhatsApp messages are between you and us. Do not include sensitive items like passwords or recovery phrases, and only send gift card details through the private link.

## A worked example of a WhatsApp order
You add products worth $230 to your cart and go to checkout. You enter your details, confirm you are 21 or older and choose Cash App. You tap "Place order and message us on WhatsApp". The order is saved with an ID such as OSV-A1B2C3, and WhatsApp opens with a message containing the reference, the items, the total of $230.00 and the method. You send it. A team member replies with the Cash App details and a link to your private payment page. You pay $230.00 with the order ID in the note, take a screenshot and upload it on the page. We confirm the payment, you receive an email, and the order moves into processing. If you had chosen crypto, the payment window would have given you the amount and address immediately, and the chat would have been for any questions.

## Why people like the WhatsApp option
Some customers prefer a conversation to a form, because they can ask a question about a product, a payment or a delivery right when they need to. Others like to see payment details in a chat on their phone, where copying and pasting is easy. Either way, the order itself lives on the site, so you get the benefits of both: a clear record and a human to talk to.

## Frequently asked questions about chat orders
### Can I pay for an order by sending money in WhatsApp?
No. Use only the payment method you chose at checkout, with the details we send from our official number and your private payment page.

### Can I change my order in the chat?
Yes, tell us what you want to change with your order ID, and wait for our confirmation. We update the order and send new details if the total changes.

### Can I place a second order in the same chat?
Yes, but each order needs its own order ID and payment. Please mention which order you are talking about in each message.

### Is there a difference for wholesale customers?
Wholesale customers can use WhatsApp too. Volume pricing is arranged through the [wholesale page](/wholesale/) or by messaging us, and we will confirm how to place the order.

### What if I need to speak to someone urgently?
Call us during business hours at 774-734-1372. WhatsApp is best for questions that can wait a little for a reply.

## Privacy in chat
Treat WhatsApp like any messaging app: only share what is needed for the order. Your order ID, the items and the payment method are fine. Your gift card details belong on the private upload page, not in a group chat or a forwarded message. Never share passwords, PINs, private keys or recovery phrases, and do not forward our payment details to others. If you want to stop a conversation, tell us, and we will continue by email.

faq.q: Is a WhatsApp order a real order?
faq.a: Yes. It is saved on our site with an ID, a private status page and an email confirmation, and the chat is a convenient way to talk to us about it.

faq.a: Payment details for Cash App, Apple Pay and Chime, and the buy link for gift cards. Crypto uses the payment window on the site.

faq.q: Can I send screenshots in chat?
faq.a: Yes, with your order ID, but uploading on the private order page is easier to track.

faq.q: Is the price different on WhatsApp?
faq.a: No. The price and discounts depend on your cart and payment method, not the channel.

faq.q: How do I know it is really you?
faq.a: Only trust the official number on our contact page. We never ask for passwords, PINs, recovery phrases or payments to personal numbers.
